text.en: Nex and Kelly proceeded with their undercover plan. Nex entered one of the library's toilet stalls.
I feel like a real criminal now
So all I have to do is just hide here until midnight right...? Sounds easy.

speaker: Nex
text: It's getting quiet...

speaker: Nex
text: How long had I been in this stall?

speaker: Nex
text: I usually love silence. But this is just... too quiet...

speaker: Nex
text: Something is just... not right...

speaker: Nex
text: I feel a little worried... what am I worrying about...?

speaker: Nex
text: ...What if... something really happened... And I won't get to see Mayu again...?

speaker: Nex
text: Why is this happening... This is... frustrating...

speaker: Nex
text: Looks like we're all on the bad side of luck...

speaker: Nex
text: ...Am I really in a university's blacklist...?

speaker: Nex
text:
There are real criminals out there, sniffing drugs and stabbing people...
Some of them just call prison a home.

speaker: Nex
text: And they shine a spotlight at me. A totally normal person...

speaker: Nex
text: Or what Kelly said is right... They just want a scapegoat...

speaker: Nex
text: ....Who exactly is that Kelly...? How can I know she wasn't just a scammer trying to pull something?

speaker: Nex
text: Maybe all of this is staged.... Maybe she tricked me to hole up in this fucking toilet...

speaker: Nex
text: And ransacked my dormitory room. Stealing my laptop and watches?

speaker: Nex
text: I'm so stupid...

speaker: Nex
text:
Funny... Today is the day I finally want to catch up with studying....
And then this shit happened...

speaker: Nex
text: Actually, since high school, I don't see a point of studying at all...

speaker: Nex
text: 80% of them graduated... Just to get unemployed... All jobs have already been taken by A.I.

speaker: Nex
text:
Despite all of that bullshit... Here I am... Struggling to climb a ladder...
Hoping to be the 20%.

speaker: Nex
text: Hope this mess ends... And I'll get back to study hard... Maybe...

speaker: Nex
text: My head is overflowing with thoughts...
("Omens" act as buffs that last until the chapter ends. You can find more of them as you progress the chapter.)
(Select 1 out of 3 Omens that favors your gameplay)

speaker: Nex
text: It's time... I guess I'll go out. Waiting was not easy at all..
